svg.text: Defense filings and witness accounts via ABC, SF Chronicle, NYT. Not a DOC log.
Wed: attempt set for 10:00; two pentobarbital doses reported
Defense: at least seven needles; one bent ~90 degrees
Team worked about one hour; snoring reported after mic cutoff
Thu night: hospital trying to clear two doses (attorneys)
Fri: attorneys say unconscious, ventilated, critically ill
Second Tennessee execution pause in five years (NYT framing)
IV-into-tissue theory is a defense claim, not a medical examiner finding.
